module_role: Commodity main-memory DRAM device (JEDEC JESD79-4 DDR4 SDRAM): a single 64-bit (72-bit ECC) double-data-rate channel that a memory controller + DDR4 PHY drives with ACTIVATE/READ/WRITE/PRECHARGE/REFRESH commands over CK_t/CK_c, exchanging data on DQS_t/DQS_c, with bank groups, gear-down, DBI, on-die VrefDQ training, write CRC, and CA parity.

integration_overview.wire_directions: CK/CK#, CKE, CS#, ODT, RAS#/CAS#/WE#, BA[2:0], A[15:0], DM, RESET#: controller → DRAM (input only). DQ, DQS/DQS#: bidirectional. TDQS/TDQS#: DRAM → controller (output only, x8 only). ZQ: tied to ground via 240 Ω. VREFDQ, VREFCA: input reference voltages.
integration_overview.rank_selection: CS# is the rank-level chip select on multi-rank DIMMs; ODT is per-rank.
integration_overview.no_handshake: Deterministic latency; data transfer follows the command without per-beat acknowledgment.
integration_overview.DIMM_routing: Standard DDR3 UDIMM/SODIMM uses fly-by command/address/control topology (instead of DDR2 T-branch); per-DRAM flight-time skew between CK and DQS is compensated by the controller via Write Leveling.

interfaces.command_address: ACT_n + RAS_n/A16 + CAS_n/A15 + WE_n/A14 + A[13:0] + BG + BA

interface_categories: Clock interface — differential CK_t/CK_c (commands on the rising edge).
Command/Address interface — ACT_n flag + multiplexed RAS_n/A16, CAS_n/A15, WE_n/A14 + address + BG/BA, with PAR parity.
Data interface — DQ + differential DQS_t/DQS_c (double data rate) + DM_n/DBI_n.
Control/alert — CKE, CS_n, ODT, RESET_n, ALERT_n, ZQ.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: RESET# is the only asynchronous control; must be deliberately driven HIGH by the controller before normal operation.
soc_dependent_items: Number of ranks and DIMM type (UDIMM / RDIMM / LRDIMM).
Device width (x4 / x8 / x16) and channel ECC (64 vs 72 bit).
Target speed bin (DDR4-1600 .. DDR4-3200) and CL/CWL.
DDR4 PHY training (write leveling, read/write training, VrefDQ training).
ODT scheme (Rtt_Nom / Rtt_WR / Rtt_PARK) and ZQ calibration.
Enabling of DBI / write CRC / CA parity / gear-down.

pull_up_resistors_terminators.termination: Differential ODT at end-of-line on DIMM (typ. 100 Ω).
Fly-by VTT termination resistors (typ. 39 Ω to VTT).
Controller-driven push-pull; board pull-up to VDD typical.

low_power_modes.Active_Power_Down: CKE LOW with banks open; tXP exit.
low_power_modes.Precharge_Power_Down_Fast_Exit: CKE LOW, MR0 A12=1; tXP exit.
low_power_modes.Precharge_Power_Down_Slow_Exit: CKE LOW, MR0 A12=0; tXPDLL exit.
low_power_modes.Self_Refresh: CKE LOW with SRE; internal refresh; CK may stop.
low_power_modes.Deep_Power_Down: Not a defined DDR3 state; requires full RESET# + power removal.

compatibility_notes: DDR4 is NOT pin- or protocol-compatible with DDR3 (POD12 1.2 V vs SSTL 1.5 V, ACT_n command flag, bank groups, different ballout).
x4, x8, x16 share the DDR4 protocol but differ in DQ width, bank-group count, and column-address count.
DDR4 RDIMM adds an RCD (register); LRDIMM adds an RCD plus Data Buffers with extra CA / data latency.
topology_description: Memory controller + DDR4 PHY -> single 64-bit (72-bit ECC) command/address/data channel -> one or more ranks of x4/x8/x16 DDR4 SDRAMs on a UDIMM/RDIMM/LRDIMM. RDIMM/LRDIMM re-clock command/address through an RCD; LRDIMM buffers data through Data Buffers (DB).
device_classes_examples: DDR4 SDRAM x4 / x8 / x16 component
DDR4 memory controller + PHY (in an SoC / FPGA)
DDR4 RCD (Registering Clock Driver) / DB (Data Buffer)
